wiki.title: Tonya Pfaff
wiki.extract: Tonya Pfaff is an American politician and former educator who has served as the Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives for the 43rd District since 2018. She represents Terre Haute, West Terre Haute, and parts of Vigo County, and serves on several standing House committees including Ways and Means, Education, and Elections & Apportionment, where she is the ranking Democrat.
